title: CMake: MSYS2: Don't link with -municode anymore
description:
Since cli_main was removed, and we don't build on Windows with
wmain() as the entry point instead of main() on the CLI tools,
-municode on MSYS2 causes the build to fail and should be removed.

Follow up to 1c72f4438d4a6bbefb20187af7de9e1c88b4c608

notes.body: enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass
